name: convert-call
description: Convert one GraphQL call to REST (guide section 5, steps 0-4) in its own worktree, ending in its own pull request for Brant to review.

call.description: Audit row id, e.g. graphql:query:allThemes (kind and domain are read from the audit row)

base.description: The GitHub branch on origin each call starts from (fetched at prepare) and its PR merges into

budget.description: Claude spend limit for this call in USD; 0 = no limit

steps.name: prepare
steps.description: Create the call worktree and its local.env, regenerate the inventory and audit, confirm category convert.

inputs.run: exec python3 scripts/factory.py prepare '${{ inputs.call }}' --base '${{ inputs.base }}'

steps.name: record_impl
steps.description: Implementer writes the golden test; the factory runs it twice (first run fails on purpose).

inputs.run: exec python3 scripts/ai.py implement '${{ inputs.call }}' record --budget ${{ inputs.budget }}

steps.name: record_matrix
steps.description: Matrix adversary adds missing input cases as tests; kept findings go back to the implementer.

inputs.run: exec python3 scripts/ai.py adversary '${{ inputs.call }}' matrix --budget ${{ inputs.budget }}
exec python3 scripts/factory.py check '${{ inputs.call }}' record
